test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Pandit Jasraj, the doyen of Hindustani classical music, was a proponent of which of the following gharanas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mewati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points- __**About Pandit Jasraj:

__
 
• He was born on 28 January 1930 in Pili Mandori, Village in Hisar District of Haryana State. Pandit Jasraj was an Indian classical vocalist, who belonged to the Mewati Gharana.
 
• Pandit Jasraj Musical Career spanned over 75 years resulting in International and National fame. He was accoladed with many National and International Awards.
 
• He conferred with some of the major awards of India they were Padma Bhushan in 1990, Padma Vibhushan 2000, Padma Shri 1975, Sangeet Natak Akademi award in 1987, etc.
 
• He died on 17th August 2020.
 
• He trained under some of the veterans like Ghulam Qadir Khan of Mewati Gharana, and Classical Vocalist Pandit Maniram.
